positioning.primary_problem: Industrial energy exposure and plant-level procurement and investment decisions in Germany
positioning.research_thesis: Public electricity market averages and plant-delivered cost economics differ; strategic choices require tariff, timing, geography and financing context.

customer_segments.buyer_job: Understand cost exposure and screen investment choices with transparent financial assumptions
Prioritize operating levers and identify plant information needed for credible site analysis
Compare tariff structures and flexibility choices, and prepare procurement decision questions

offer.format: versioned downloadable PDF with appendix and evidence notes
deliverables: Eurostat industrial tariff comparison with exact bands and definitions
Industrial plant and procurement archetype implications
Illustrative and fully labelled BESS cash-flow case
Strategy options and 90-day management action agenda
source_requirements: Primary-source claims traceable to source URL and exact locus
Exact base/period/unit/adjustment for every data exhibit
Any SMARD 573-vs-576 discrepancy resolved or clearly disclosed
not_included: Legally binding advisory or investment recommendation

commercial_choices.pricing_basis: Low-friction first-sale hypothesis; no evidenced willingness-to-pay study
commercial_choices.licence: Single legal entity internal evaluation, non-transferable; final contract to be reviewed
candidate_providers: Razorpay international card/checkout subject to account activation
Skydo invoiced cross-border B2B collection subject to product eligibility

paid_custom_diagnostic.next_step: Request a diagnostic; quote after qualification

digital_customer_journey.cta: Request a plant energy exposure diagnostic

B.name: Forecast-inclusive V1
features: Independently approved manufacturing forecast and uncertainty model

Approve payment provider/merchant configuration after technical compliance preflight
open_owner_decisions.default_recommendation: Razorpay hosted checkout if eligible; Skydo invoice fallback

open_owner_decisions.decision: Approve legal operator, tax, transaction, refund and privacy terms after qualified review

No legal, licence, payment-processor or domain approval
